intro.title: Typing Functions
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple TypeScript program that defines and uses typed functions. You will learn how to specify the types of parameters and return values to make your functions more predictable and error-resistant. The core concept is using TypeScript's type annotations to enforce function signatures, which helps catch mistakes during development. You will work with basic function declarations, arrow functions, and optional parameters. By the end, you'll understand how typing functions improves code safety and clarity in TypeScript projects.
intro.usecase: Typing functions is essential for building reliable TypeScript applications like e-commerce checkout systems, where you need to ensure price calculation functions receive correct numeric inputs and return properly formatted totals. In dashboard applications, typed event handlers guarantee filter functions only accept valid date ranges or user selections, preventing runtime errors. API integration layers rely on typed callback functions to handle asynchronous responses with predictable data structures. This practice catches mismatched parameters and return values during development rather than in production.
